newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Tranz Rail says 15 pct over-allotment exercised.
newsitem.headline: Tranz Rail says 15 pct over-allotment exercised.

text.p: Tranz Rail Holdings said on Wednesday that underwriters to the secondary offering by Berkshire Fund III had exercised the 15 percent over-allotment option granted to them by the selling shareholders.
As a result, 11.32 million ordinary shares in the form of American Depositary shares have been sold to the underwriters at a price of US$18.00 per ADS.
Each ADS is equivalent to three ordinary shares.
The offering was settled on Tuesday.
The global coordinator for the offer was Goldman Sachs.
Berkshire Fund III, which previously held 13.51 percent of Tranz Rail, now has 4.68 percent, a Tranz Rail spokeswoman said.
Wisconsin Central Transportation Corp owns 22.65 percent of Tranz Rail, while New Zealand merchant bank Fay Richwhite, through Pacific Rail, owns 18.73 percent.
Tranz Rail shares were down six cents at $8.60 in late trade. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
